fr_html: Ils ne peuvent prendre part au règlement des affaires dans lesquelles eux ou leurs parents ou alliés jusqu'au troisième degré inclusivement ont un intérêt personnel direct.
en_html: They may not take part in the decision of any case in which they, members of their family or their connections up to and including the third degree, have a direct personal interest.
